tasks.intent:
Implement spec/npu.md under rtl/ only. Develop and repair using
python3 tools/smoke.py; the checker is immutable. Write only rtl/** and build/**.
Do not read other trials, supplied implementations, evaluator references or
parent projects. Do not spawn agents or make subordinate model calls.
Use the installed Icarus/Verilator and Python. No external IP is permitted in
either treatment. The total trial budget, including planning and checking,
is 600 seconds. Finish with NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"rtl":{"module":"nebula_npu_dot4"}}.

brief.objective: Deliver fresh original synthesizable SystemVerilog for nebula_npu_dot4 satisfying spec/npu.md and the immutable common NPU contract.
responsibilities: Implement the specified clk, rst_n, req_valid, req_ready, req_a[31:0], req_b[31:0], rsp_valid, rsp_ready, rsp_data[31:0], and kill interface.
Compute the signed INT32 sum of four signed INT8 products using four parallel multipliers, with lane 0 in bits 7:0 and products widened before reduction.
Accept on req_valid && req_ready at edge n, assert the result after edge n+2, and hold valid/data until consumed; permit at most one outstanding operation.
Make reset and kill dominate acceptance and output, cancel pending work, and support correct recovery.
Develop and repair with the immutable python3 tools/smoke.py checker within the 600-second total trial budget, including planning and checking.
Read only spec/**, tb/**, tools/smoke.py, rtl/**, and build/**; write only rtl/** and build/**. Use only the permitted python3, git, iverilog, vvp, and verilator tools.
exclusions: Do not modify the specification, testbench, or checker.
Do not read other trials, supplied implementations, evaluator references, or parent projects.
Do not use external IP, spawn agents, or make subordinate model calls.
Do not add hidden accumulation, memory, saturation, or rounding.
completion_criteria: Deliver the RTL snapshot implementing the full arithmetic, timing, handshake, cancellation, and recovery contract.
Run the common-public-smoke L1 hard gate with python3 tools/smoke.py, a 120-second timeout, and expected NPU_SMOKE_PASS; report any failure under the predefined on_failure=report policy.
Finish within the 600-second trial budget with the required NEBULA_OUTPUT declaration.
collaboration: Provide the rtl output to task:npu-pilot-1:audit for independent public verification.

tasks.intent: Independently replay public checks on the selected design Delivery. Report genuine passed or failed; no RTL/checker changes.

brief.objective: Independently replay the immutable public checker on the selected design delivery and retain its genuine verdict.

responsibilities: Consume the rtl.snapshot from npu-pilot-1:design, output rtl.
Execute the predefined tool command python3 tools/audit.py and retain the actual public-check results.
Read only rtl/**, tb/**, and tools/**; write only build/**. Use only the permitted python3, iverilog, and vvp tools.
exclusions: Do not change RTL, testbenches, or checkers.
Do not replace or reinterpret the actual passed or failed verdict.
Do not introduce additional hard gates or feedback routes.
completion_criteria: Replay the public checker against the selected RTL delivery using python3 tools/audit.py.
Produce build/audit.json and build/audit.log recording the genuine verdict and execution evidence, whether passed or failed.
collaboration: Verify the selected rtl delivery from task:npu-pilot-1:design.
